scenario: Id beyond 64-bit range: Werkzeug's <int:> converter MATCHES it (Python ints are unbounded), the handler then 500s when SQLite rejects the oversized integer

body.error: Python int too large to convert to SQLite INTEGER

notes: SURPRISE: the contract doc claims the <int:> converter 404s overflowing values, but Werkzeug's IntegerConverter accepts any \d+ (Python ints are unbounded); sqlite3 then raises OverflowError, caught by the route's blanket except -> 500 with the leaked str(exception). Grade on status 500 + {error: string} shape only, never the message text. A Rust port whose path param is i64 will naturally 404 here instead; this fixture records the Python behavior for the parity decision.
